name: live-preview
description: A pane with a real screenshot of your dev server, taken again after every turn in which Claude edits a frontend file, with a phone-sized view and a button that adds the capture to your prompt.

url.title: Dev server URL
url.description: Page to capture, http or https. /preview <url> changes it for the session.

browser.title: Browser
browser.description: Chrome, Chromium or Edge executable. Empty tries google-chrome, chromium, microsoft-edge on PATH and the standard macOS app locations.

browserArgs.title: Extra browser arguments
browserArgs.description: Comma-separated extra flags, e.g. --no-sandbox in a root container.

watch.title: Watched extensions
watch.description: Comma-separated file extensions whose edits trigger a new capture. Empty means the usual frontend set.
